title: Nolita Medium Pebbled Leather Chain Pochette
description_html:
Nolita Medium Pebbled Leather Chain Pochette by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 11.25”W X 4.5”H X 2.5”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 10.5""
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 37% rayon/24% polyester/24% cotton/15% linen
  • Closure: Zip fastening
